name: GRAPH_V3_OFFLINE_PILOT_01
scope: Offline mechanism validation only; fixed saved B; released oracle geometry for solve, all active geometry for evaluation

selection.a: Exactly the 20 saved Graph v2 cases, no reselection
selection.b: P0 every applied FRESH ID43 through last switch at/before first recorded whole-footprint far-X passage of dynamic box (ID75). No exclusion based on solver/performance.
selection.PD_stress: RAW PP is counterfactual at saved B; previous actual PD v,w is continuity/acceleration initial condition; actual PD replay verified separately.

horizon_rule: H_switch: all intervals to next actual switch (not capped at16); final/collision terminal pose if no next switch, explicitly right-censored. H_chunk: follow frozen chunk until existing 0.01m endpoint criterion, capped at60s; timeout retained. No future FRESH/1s waypoint expiry during this offline continuation. No collision early termination; overlaps are diagnostic counterfactual.
entry_rule: Existing XYPath.project on RAW at B, outgoing segment at a vertex; freeze original endpoint indices and interpolation fraction for all boundary factors/diagnostics. PP itself keeps its original projection rule.
heading_rule: For each node choose the nearest later node with chord length >=20mm; if none, the nearest earlier node with >=20mm chord, oriented in path order. Freeze these indices before solving; reject if any node has no such chord. These are auxiliary headings, not native yaw.
rigid_rule: One SE(2) transform aligning initial node 0 position and its valid auxiliary heading to B; preserve all relative transforms

factors.boundary: SE(2) log from fixed B to fixed-entry interpolated editable pose
factors.pp_continuity: Retain clipped applied-w continuity, now from variable-speed rollout; add unclipped kappa_PP - previous actual w/max(previous v,0.05), sigma0.5/m, before clipping. Prior/relative/boundary/tangent/anti-shrink/native safety inherited unchanged.
factors.anti_shrink: Hinges on each original segment ratio, total XY length ratio and frozen heading chord ratio
factors.safety: Same 0.025m soft obstacle target and existing corridor target; variable-speed 9Hz/72Hz H_switch rollout using only released geometry. H_chunk is evaluation only.
factors.side: Frozen RAW definite-side crossings only, sigma0.02m; no side factor if undefined or undisclosed.

solver.initialization: Zero additive XY/yaw increments at observation-anchored FRESH; one solve per selected case; no restarts

improvement_rule.rules: Safe native AND safe H_switch rollout AND corridor contained; obstacle/corridor minimum loss versus RAW <=5mm for both native and rollout; H_switch travel >=70% RAW and no endpoint stop/truncation; converged for Graph; delta-w decreases. Same constraints for Speed comparison, with angular decrease against RAW+Speed and additionally retain >=70% its travel. H_chunk-qualified additionally requires endpoint reached and native/H_chunk safe with <=5mm loss vs RAW H_chunk. Report all failures; no best-case filtering.
improvement_rule.primary_reference: RAW+Speed for Graph v3 contribution; RAW comparison secondary
improvement_rule.stress_recovery: RAW native-or-rollout collision/margin/corridor unsafe -> candidate native-and-rollout safe, separately per horizon. H_chunk safety requires endpoint completion, not just safe prefix.

variable_speed.rule: target=clip(0.4/abs(kappa_PP),0.05,0.2), zero kappa target0.2. Choose closest target within previous-v +/-0.5/9. omega=clip(v*kappa,-0.4,0.4). Continue when clipped. Same RAW+Speed/Graphv3.
variable_speed.initial_v: Previous actual executed command one 9Hz tick before B; no reset to target speed
variable_speed.endpoint: Endpoint completion terminates counterfactual before issuing v=0, not in-place recovery. H_switch completion before requested horizon is a stop/truncation and cannot qualify. H_chunk natural endpoint completion is reported separately.
variable_speed.speed_profile: Ordered control samples of projected path arclength and executed/target speed from B. Repeated arclength retained with control ordinal because acceleration/pose are stateful; not native waypoint time or a universal open-loop v(s).

geometry_information: Static geometry always available. Dynamic included in solve only if next actually captured RGB after first visible frame completed before B host monotonic time. Validate RGB magenta hashes; freeze available set during solve. Evaluation uses all actually active geometry at B. Same reconstructed next-frame rule for older stress data.
side_rule: World-axis aligned boxes: intersect RAW native full XY segments with x=center_x. Require all crossings strictly outside size_y/2+radius, all same sign; ambiguous/absent/vertical crossings SIDE_UNDEFINED. Define signed lateral as y-center_y (+Y left). Freeze crossing endpoint indices/fractions for factor; hinge sign*interpolated_offset >= halfwidth+radius. Only released boxes. Re-evaluate corrected path/rollout side separately; no claim of completed bypass from sign alone.
graph_v2_reuse: Reuse saved S0 optimized XY/heading and solver outcomes without solving v2 again; re-evaluate at identical new H_switch and H_chunk. V2 original optimization horizon16 retained in metadata. b/c absent v2 = NOT_AVAILABLE, no new v2 solve.
